issues.description: Exercise 3 (multiple-solution Grover) in the problem statement and the reference solution treat the oracle's argument as a list of bit-strings (list[str]) named `combinations`, but the template's oracle signature declares the parameter as a single string (`combinations: str`). This creates an API mismatch between the template and both the problem text and the solution: students implementing the subclass/override may be confused about the expected type and how to call the oracle, and the subclassing/override pattern used in the exercises becomes inconsistent.
issues.suggested_fix: Change the template oracle signature to accept a list of bit-strings to match the problem statement and solution. For example, in template_repository/ex3_grover_multi_qubit_multi_solutions_with_auxiliary_qubit.py update the method signature to: def oracle(self, qc: QuantumCircuit, query_register: QuantumRegister, auxiliary_register: QuantumRegister, combinations: list[str]) -> QuantumCircuit: and update the docstring accordingly. This keeps the template API consistent with the exercise description and the reference solution.
